2609.01316.title: MIDR: Enrichment-Augmented Indexing for Multimodal Document Retrieval
2609.01316.paper_summary: Retrieval over visually rich documents has a representation problem: important content often lives in tables, charts, figures, and layout relations that plain OCR linearizes, corrupts, or omits. ColPali-family visual retrievers address this with patch-level multi-vector indexes and late-interaction scoring, keeping image-derived retrieval on the query-time serving path. We introduce MIDR (Multimodal Indexing for Document Retrieval), a training-free framework for enrichment-augmented indexing that shifts multimodal reasoning to index time. During ingestion, a multimodal LLM converts rendered pages into verified textual fields that are indexed with BM25F and optionally fused with dense retrieval, enabling text-centric serving over multimodally grounded evidence. On ViDoRe V3, MIDR Hybrid achieves 0.6219 average nDCG across five English domains, a 23.0% relative gain over BM25, remaining competitive with ColQwen2.5. On two French-document domains, enrichment bridges English queries and French page text, lifting BM25 from 0.1532 to 0.5448 nDCG and outperforming ColQwen2.5. Across all seven domains, MIDR leads ColQwen2.5 on four while using approximately 9x smaller index memory and approximately 2x lower query latency. These results establish index-time multimodal reasoning as a compelling accuracy-deployment alternative to serving-time visual late interaction.
2609.01316.paper_summary_zh: 檢索視覺豐富的文檔存在一個表示問題：重要內容通常位於表格、圖表、圖形和佈局關係中，而普通的光學字符識別（OCR）會將其線性化、損壞或省略。ColPali家族的視覺檢索器通過補丁級多向量索引和後期互動評分來解決這個問題，將圖像衍生的檢索保持在查詢時的服務路徑上。我們介紹了MIDR（多模態文檔檢索索引），這是一個無需訓練的增強索引框架，將多模態推理轉移到索引時間。在攝取過程中，多模態大語言模型（LLM）將渲染頁面轉換為經過驗證的文本字段，這些字段使用BM25F進行索引，並可選擇與密集檢索融合，使得基於文本的服務能夠在多模態基礎證據上進行。在ViDoRe V3上，MIDR Hybrid在五個英語領域中實現了0.6219的平均nDCG，相較於BM25提高了23.0%的相對增益，並與ColQwen2.5保持競爭。在兩個法語文檔領域中，增強橋接了英語查詢和法語頁面文本，將BM25從0.1532提升至0.5448 nDCG，並超越了ColQwen2.5。在所有七個領域中，MIDR在四個領域領先ColQwen2.5，同時使用的索引內存約為其的9倍小，查詢延遲約為其的2倍低。這些結果確立了索引時間的多模態推理作為一種引人注目的準確性部署替代方案，以取代服務時間的視覺後期互動。
